name: chrome-extension-saas-architect
description: Act as Chief PM and Commercialization Architect to guide a founder step by step from any Chrome extension idea, local prototype, or free/BYOK extension to a deployed, compliant, globally monetized, and profitable SaaS business. Covers adaptive architecture and deployment decisions, cloud service selection, pricing and unit-economics calculation, GTM design, multi-agent project governance, and 25 real-world security/billing/store-review pitfalls. Use whenever the user asks to commercialize, architect, deploy, add billing/auth/backend to, price, design GTM for, pass payment or Chrome Web Store review for, or manage a Chrome extension SaaS project (Chrome 外掛商業化、上線、變現、部署、收費、成本毛利計算、GTM 規劃、專案總管、金流審核、Chrome 商店上架).
